"What, you think you're some type of Jedi?". You can dislike Jar Jar all you want, but you gotta love [[Watto]]!

This Effect is an integral component to flipping the objective "[[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]]". Basically, you need at least four cards under here to flip. How to get cards under here? Drain or win battle at [[Watto]]'s Junkyard.

In addition, this card provides irrevocable direct damage of 1 Force for every drain or battle you win at the Junkyard. Even better is that it is dependent only upon you initiating the drain. Thus even if the drain is canceled, they still lose 1 to Credits. Similarly, even if [[Ghhhk]] gets the opponent out of battle damage, they still lose 1 to here.

Combo:

Not easy to get them all out (only DTF can be started with), but initiate and win a battle at the Junkyard and you have retrieved a Force, while opponent has lost 3 Force (2 of them not even making it to the Lost Pile!).
|combos=* [[Credits Will Do Fine]] + [[I Feel The Conflict]] + [[Draw Their Fire]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Credits%20Will%20Do%20Fine</ref>
* [[Credits Will Do Fine]] + [[Master Qui-Gon (V)]]
|rulings=* If a player loses Force from hand to stack here, it is first revealed to both players, then stacked face down.<ref name="scomp" />
* If a player loses Force from Life Force to stack here, it is not revealed to anyone. Stack it face down, unseen.
* Text referring to cards stacked 'on'/'under'/'beneath' this Effect all means the same thing.
* Neither player may view Dark's cards after they are stacked face down here.
